drawings.description: en marge gauche, petit schéma d'un quadrant $E_2^{pq}$ : deux axes, une croix à l'origine et une rangée de croix sur l'axe horizontal.
drawings.notes: Two axes; a heavy cross (asterisk) at the origin, one cross just above it on the vertical axis, and a row of three crosses to the right, drawn slightly above the horizontal axis.

drawings.description: Dans la marge gauche, à hauteur de (4.1.4), un croquis en cube des cinq schémas au-dessus de $S$ : $V \leftarrow \bar V$, $V_\eta$, $V_{\bar\eta}$ en haut, $S$, $\bar S$, $\eta$, $\bar\eta$, $s$ en bas, reliés par des flèches ; plusieurs traits sont repassés et une partie du croquis est biffée.
drawings.notes: A cube drawn as on the page. Top face: V <- V-bar; behind them V_eta and V_eta-bar, joined by heavy strokes to V and V-bar and to each other (no arrowheads on the page). Verticals: V down to S, V-bar down to S-bar (heavy, ending in a blot), a thin one from V_eta down to eta, a thin one from V_eta-bar down to eta-bar. Middle: S <- S-bar (the tail curled), with small s and s-bar each with a short arrow to S and to S-bar; bottom: eta <- eta-bar (the tail curled), with oblique arrows eta -> S and eta-bar -> S-bar. To the right, a second V over S joined by a vertical. Left out: the struck group of long oblique strokes at the right, over a V and an S-bar (struck with it), and a faint pencil line from it towards V. Subscripts read after the transcription. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): one continuous zigzag runs over the group at the right, across its V, its S-bar and the strokes joining them, while the V over S just left of it is untouched; the group is struck and stays left out. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: Encadré dans la marge gauche, avec l'en-tête « remarquer le diagramme et le \uncertain{commutatif} ! » écrit en oblique : un carré $V \leftarrow V_\eta$ (flèche épaisse, étiquette biffée), $V_s \simeq V_{\bar s} \to V$ (notée $i$), $\bar V \simeq V_{\bar\eta} \to V_\eta$ (notée $h_\eta$), et en bas une flèche pointillée $k$ de $V_s \simeq V_{\bar s}$ vers $\bar V \simeq V_{\bar\eta}$. Sous le carré : « (avec des notations légèrement différentes de celles de (4.2)) ».
drawings.notes: In a frame open on the left: the oblique header (not reproduced as text, only its place), the square V <= V_eta (thick arrow), V_s = V_s-bar -> V (i), V-bar = V_eta-bar -> V_eta (h_eta), and the dotted arrow k from V_s = V_s-bar to V-bar = V_eta-bar. Omitted as struck: the label scribbled out over the thick arrow, the scribble just left of i, and a short struck stroke above V-bar = V_eta-bar. The label i itself is not struck (the transcription reads it) and is now drawn in ink. The two lines of text below the square are not reproduced. Issue 128, 2026-11-09: struck material left out after a fresh check of the facsimile (struck-out material is not drawn). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the scribble stands to the left of the letter i and does not touch it; the i is clean, as the transcription reads it, and stays drawn. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: Diagramme de schémas : en haut $X \leftarrow X_K \leftarrow X_{\tilde U}$, en bas $S \hookleftarrow U \leftarrow \bar U$, flèches verticales dans les deux sens (projections et sections) entre $X$ et $S$, $X_K$ et $U$ ; au milieu $X$ (en gras) $\Leftarrow \tilde X$, et $s \leftarrow \bar s$ sous $U$ et $\bar U$ ; à droite, $F_{\bar a}$.
drawings.notes: Top: X <- X_K <- X_U-tilde; middle: the bold X <= X-tilde (a double arrow), F_a-bar at the right; bottom: S <-(hooked) U <- U-bar, and s <- s-bar below. Between X and S, and between X_K and U: a straight arrow down and a curved arrow up (projections and sections). Oblique arrows: X -> X_K (heavy), X-tilde -> X_U-tilde, s -> U, s-bar -> U-bar. Verticals: a heavy double stroke from the bold X down to s, crossing U <- U-bar; a stroke from X-tilde down towards s-bar; a short vertical stroke crossing X <= X-tilde under X_U-tilde (drawn as on the page). Left out: the long pencil lines across the page (lower left, upper right); the B_Gamma ... P square below is typeset in the transcription. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
